overview.description: State Street My2032 Municipal Bond ETF is an actively managed target-maturity exchange-traded fund that seeks to maximize current income exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in 2032 and is designed to distribute remaining principal and liquidate on or about December 15, 2032.
